name: Music box
text: Plays one tune. Nobody remembers teaching it.

name: Tin soldier
text: Stands to attention whenever you leave the room.

name: Porcelain doll
text: Her eyes follow the customer, never you.

name: Jack-in-the-box
text: The crank sticks at the exact wrong note.

name: Little rocking horse
text: Rocks at night. The floor has opinions.

name: Spinning top
text: Spins a little longer than physics allows.

name: Marionette
text: The strings are cut. It still bows.

name: Paper toy theatre
text: Tiny audience included. They do not clap.

name: Silver locket
text: Holds a curl of hair and a very small argument.

name: Signet ring
text: The crest belongs to a family that denies it.

name: Pocket watch
text: Runs on time you have not used yet.

name: Cameo brooch
text: The profile faces a different way each morning.

name: Mourning ring
text: Black enamel, still politely grieving.

name: Pearl necklace
text: One pearl is always slightly warm.

name: Jet hatpin
text: Long enough to be rude about.

name: Charm bracelet
text: There is a charm for every mistake.

name: Violin
text: Tunes itself when you stop paying attention.

name: Harmonica
text: Mostly wind. Some of it is not yours.

name: Hand bell
text: Rings once for service, once for company.

name: Tuning fork
text: Hums a note the room tries to avoid.

name: Accordion
text: Wheezes like it has seen things.

name: Clay ocarina
text: Sounds like a question, every single time.

name: Metronome
text: Keeps time for somebody's heartbeat.

name: Gramophone
text: The record never ends. Neither does the crackle.

name: Old ledger
text: Every page balances. Nobody knows against what.

name: Atlas
text: Includes one country that is currently sulking.

name: Locked diary
text: The lock is a suggestion. The entries are a warning.

name: Water-stained hymnal
text: Page 40 is stuck together with candle wax.

name: Farmer's almanac
text: Predicts yesterday's weather with eerie accuracy.

name: Photo album
text: There is one extra person in every photograph.

name: Pressed-flower herbarium
text: Pressed flowers, one still wilting on purpose.

name: First edition
text: Signed by the author, in a hurry, from the inside.

name: Hand mirror
text: Shows you slightly better than you look. Suspicious.

name: Candlestick
text: Burns steady even when the room holds its breath.

name: Oil portrait
text: The sitter would like the frame back.

name: Brass key
text: Fits nothing here. Fits something somewhere.

name: Snow globe
text: It only snows when the shop is empty.

name: Taxidermy owl
text: Glass eyes, and a rather good memory.

name: Ship in a bottle
text: The tiny crew has stopped waving.

name: Mantel clock
text: Chimes thirteen, then apologizes.

name: Wind-up frog
text: Hops toward you, then hops toward your ankles.

name: Kaleidoscope
text: Turn it and the pattern turns back.

name: Paper kite
text: Pulls toward the cellar door in any wind.

name: Pearl tiepin
text: Keeps a dead man's collar from straying.

name: Opal earrings
text: Flash green at the mention of money.

name: Tortoiseshell comb
text: Still tidying someone who is no longer here.

name: Brass kazoo
text: Even a ghost cannot hum along seriously.

name: Tambourine
text: Jingles in the hallway. Nobody is holding it.

name: Zither
text: One string is tuned to a room that burned.

name: Sheet music
text: Notes in the margin: 'Do not play the last bar.'

name: Bestiary
text: The drawings are neater than the claims.

name: Guestbook
text: Every signature is dated tomorrow.

name: Horseshoe
text: Hung the right way up. It keeps turning over.

name: Ship's lantern
text: Lights the way to wherever it was last unwelcome.

name: Plaster death mask
text: Smiling, which is the worst part.

name: Wax seal stamp
text: Stamps a crest nobody can find afterwards.
